Role & responsibilities




We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of overall experience, preferably within the Financial Services industry. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in full stack application development and have exposure to Investment Banking domains. Treasury experience or domain knowledge will be considered a strong advantage. The candidate should demonstrate excellent technical proficiency, problem solving capabilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and innovative solutions.




Key Responsibilities

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Python, AWS, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, Kafka, FastAPI, and React, with hands-on experience in designing and developing scalable enterprise applications. • Exposure to Investment Banking, Hedge Funds, Private Equity, or Treasury domains is highly preferred. The candidate should demonstrate proficiency in REST API development, advanced SQL programming, and cloud-native application development.

• Familiarity with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, and Secrets Manager is expected.

Experience with modern full stack architectures and distributed systems will be an added advantage.
The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions within demanding timelines.



Example Business Problem Statements (Resume Indicators)

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be highly preferred:

Automated Corporate Actions processing through SWIFT messaging frameworks to reduce manual operational effort and improve efficiency. • Designed and implemented Investment Operations approval and payment workflows based on configurable authorization thresholds.

• Developed solutions for DTCC trade confirmation connectivity across Corporate Bonds and Asset-Backed Securities.

Enhanced Trade Settlement and post-trade operations through automated SWIFT message exchanges with custodian banks.

Built systems for generating electronically signed instructions and financial documents to support secure transfer of securities and funds while meeting compliance requirements.



Preferred candidate profile

Communication: Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to engage confidently with stakeholders, business users, and senior leadership.

• Leadership: Strong critical thinking capabilities with the ability to drive innovative solutions and influence technical decisions.




• Ownership & Accountability: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of taking end-to-end ownership of deliverables.

• Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional and globally distributed teams in fast-paced environments.

• Analytical Thinking: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a strong attention to detail and a data-driven approach to decision-making.

• Adaptability: Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver quality outcomes under tight deadlines and changing business requirements.
